verses.1: A prayer for their forgiveness, by David.
verses.2: But to God, my soul is saved from this torment.
verses.3: But he is my savior; he has saved me from my downfall. I cannot be deceived by his words.
verses.4: Until Anah becomes a wall that blocks everyone from approaching her.
verses.5: But when they bring him before them, they desire to banish him. They bless him with their words, but in their hearts, they curse him.
verses.6: But to God, I offer my soul, for from Him comes my prayer.
verses.7: But he is my savior; I am saved from my downfall. I will not be lost.
verses.8: I will seek refuge and honor in God. May He protect me from all harm.
verses.9: Let us trust in Him at all times, when people bring their prayers before Him. May God protect us from harm.
verses.10: But human beings are like lies; they are children of men who deceive others with their words. They are all part of that deceitful world.
verses.11: Do not rely on fraud and theft. Do not waste your lives in vain. For they will not bring any good to you.
verses.12: One of God’s words is this: “I have heard it, for it is true from God.”
verses.13: And go, O Lord of mercy, for you will repay each person according to his actions.
